title.narrative: Improving performance accountability in the Dominican Republic by strengthening Congressional oversight

description.narrative: The objective of this proposal is to improve performance accountability in the DR by strengthening Congress institutional capacity to conduct its oversight role within the new public financial management (PFM) framework. The Dominican Republic has recently approved major laws that redefine the role of the institutions involved in the planning and budgeting processes and pave the way for the adoption of a medium-term expenditure framework and the use of performance information to improve public spending. It is critical thus that Congress develops capacity for using performance information to hold the Executive accountable and conducting budget oversight in a multi-annual framework. The Congress has already taken some steps in this regard, streamlining its organizational design and reforming the House's internal bylaws. This grant will complement this institutional reform process by supporting: (i) The establishment of a Congressional Advisory Office (Oficina Permanente de Asesoría, OPA) that will provide technical support to the two Chambers: the Senate and the Lower House. (ii) Institutional capacity building activities on the new PFM framework and comparative parliamentary budget oversight practices targeted at legislators, relevant legislative Commissions, their technical staff, and other key permanent staff in Congress (iii) The expansion and upgrading of the legislative information system (Sistema de Información Legislativa, SIL) to better serve the information requests from both lawmakers and the general public. The objective of this proposal is to improve accountability for public sector performance in the DR by strengthening the institutional capacity of Congress to conduct its oversight role within the new public financial management (PFM) framework. Overall, the project will contribute to strengthening the Congressional oversight role by improving its capacity to analyze and monitor budgets and performance within the new public expenditure framework - enhancing the transparency and accountability of the budget process. In turn, this will improve the public's trust in Congress and enhance communication between Congress and civil society.
